cd E:/VinAI/RoboMind_project/P-011 && PYTHONIOENCODING=utf-8 .venv/Scripts/python.exe - <<'PYEOF'
import json, pathlib, collections, shutil

live = pathlib.Path(".ai-log/session.jsonl")
backup = pathlib.Path(".ai-log/session.jsonl.rotating.bak")
shutil.copy2(live, backup)                      # an toan truoc khi ghi de

snapshot = backup.read_bytes()                  # chup mot lan, hook co the van ghi tiep
lines = [b for b in snapshot.split(b"\n") if b]
buckets: dict[str, list[bytes]] = collections.defaultdict(list)
for b in lines:
    buckets[json.loads(b.decode("utf-8"))["ts"][:10]].append(b)

moved = 0
for day, rows in sorted(buckets.items()):
    target = pathlib.Path(f".ai-log/archive/{day}.jsonl")
    before = len([x for x in target.read_bytes().split(b"\n") if x]) if target.exists() else 0
    with open(target, "ab") as fh:              # noi vao cuoi, khong bao gio ghi de
        fh.write(b"\n".join(rows) + b"\n")
    after = len([x for x in target.read_bytes().split(b"\n") if x])
    print(f"  {target}: {before} -> {after}  (+{after - before})")
    moved += len(rows)

# Chi cat dung phan da chuyen. Bat ky dong nao hook viet them sau luc chup
# van o lai trong session.jsonl - khong mot dong nao bi mat.
now = live.read_bytes()
assert now.startswith(snapshot), "session.jsonl khong con bat dau bang ban da chup"
live.write_bytes(now[len(snapshot):])
print(f"\nda chuyen {moved} dong | session.jsonl con {len([x for x in live.read_bytes().split(chr(10).encode()) if x])} dong (hook ghi them sau luc chup)")
PYEOF
tool_input.description: Rotate the session log into dated archives

    arc += [b for b in pathlib.Path(f".ai-log/archive/{d}.jsonl").read_bytes().split(b"\n") if b]
missing = [b for b in snap if b not in set(arc)]
print(f"dong trong ban chup: {len(snap)} | thieu trong archive: {len(missing)}")

# 2. khong trung lap trong tung archive
for d in ("2026-08-30", "2026-08-31"):
    rows = [b for b in pathlib.Path(f".ai-log/archive/{d}.jsonl").read_bytes().split(b"\n") if b]
    ts = [json.loads(b)["ts"] for b in rows]
    days = collections.Counter(t[:10] for t in ts)
